templates.name: Certificate of completion
templates.description: A landscape certificate with a gold seal: the recipient's name set large, the course they completed, the completion date and an optional signature block.

fields.label: Recipient name
fields.description: The person receiving the certificate, printed as the largest line.

fields.label: Course
fields.description: What the person completed.

fields.label: Completion date
fields.description: When the course was completed. A YYYY-MM-DD date is written out in full (12 March 2026); any other text prints as given.

fields.label: Issued by
fields.description: The organisation awarding the certificate, printed across the top.

fields.label: Signer name
fields.description: Printed under the signature line.

fields.label: Signer title
fields.description: The signer's role, printed under their name.

templates.name: Letter
templates.description: A plain, well-set letter: sender and date at the top, the recipient's address, an optional subject line, the body text and a signed close.

fields.label: Recipient name
fields.description: Who the letter is to. Used in the address block and in the greeting ("Dear Adaeze Nwachukwu,").

fields.label: Letter text
fields.example:
Thank you for another year with the club.

Your membership renews on 1 May.
fields.description: The text of the letter, without the greeting or the sign-off, which the template adds. A blank line starts a new paragraph. If it starts with "Dear", the template leaves out its own greeting.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: The letter's date, top right. A YYYY-MM-DD date is written out in full (18 March 2026); any other text prints as given.

fields.label: Sender name
fields.description: Who the letter is from, printed at the top and under the sign-off.

fields.label: Sender title
fields.description: The sender's role or organisation, printed under their name.

fields.label: Address line 1
fields.description: First line of the recipient's address.

fields.label: Address line 2
fields.description: Second line of the recipient's address, such as town and postcode.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: A one-line subject, printed in bold above the greeting.

templates.name: Donation receipt
templates.description: A one-page receipt that thanks the donor and records the gift: amount, date received, receipt number, and the organisation's name, address and tax ID.

fields.label: Donor name
fields.description: The person or organisation who gave.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: The amount received, with its currency symbol ("$1,250.00"). A bare number prints with two decimals and no symbol.

fields.label: Date received
fields.description: When the gift was received. A YYYY-MM-DD date is written out in full (November 14, 2025); any other text prints as given.

fields.label: Receipt number
fields.description: Your reference for this receipt.

fields.label: Organisation
fields.description: The organisation that received the gift, printed at the top.

fields.label: Organisation address
fields.description: The organisation's address, under its name. Line breaks are kept.

fields.label: Tax ID
fields.description: The organisation's tax ID or charity registration number.

fields.label: Notes
fields.example: No goods or services were provided in exchange for this gift.
fields.description: A statement printed under the gift, such as whether anything was given in return.

templates.name: Job offer letter
templates.description: A one-page offer letter: the role, start date, salary, manager and reply-by date set out as a short list of terms, with an acceptance block for the candidate to sign.

fields.label: Candidate name
fields.description: The person being offered the job. Used in the address block, the greeting and the acceptance signature line.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The job title being offered.

fields.label: Start date
fields.description: The first day of work. A YYYY-MM-DD date is written out in full (September 14, 2026); any other text prints as given.

fields.label: Salary
fields.description: The pay, as it should read ("$118,000 per year"). A bare number prints with thousands separators and no symbol.

fields.label: Manager name
fields.description: Who the candidate will report to. Also signs the letter.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The employer, printed at the top and in the offer sentence.

fields.label: Candidate address
fields.description: The candidate's address, on one line under their name.

fields.label: Reply by
fields.description: The date the candidate should accept by. A YYYY-MM-DD date is written out in full; any other text prints as given.
